articles.title: OSB Group (LSE:OSB) Stock Looks Undervalued On Fresh Loan Book Growth
articles.summary: OSB Group has seen its share price travel a long way in recent years, and the latest set of updates now puts the focus squarely on whether the current £5.10 level is justified by what the bank is earning. Investors are left weighing a solid operational story against the question of what those earnings are really worth today. Over the past 3 years the stock has returned 84.2%, which puts a lot of weight on the idea that OSB Group’s earnings profile can support a meaningfully higher valuation...
